import_provenance.original_statement: For every ideal clutter and nonnegative integral element capacities, does the dual of its minimum-weight covering LP have an optimal packing whose coordinates are dyadic rationals, with denominators powers of 2? This asks whether integrality of the covering polyhedron forces a uniform arithmetic structure on optimal fractional packings.
import_provenance.supplied_caveat: Remark: The 2025 dyadic-packing theorem for dijoins settles a special case, not all ideal clutters; the 2026 local-dyadic work also treats a weaker conjecture and special cases. See Guenin’s publication list: https://www.math.uwaterloo.ca/~bguenin/papers.html.
